verses.1: For the leader. Of David, the servant of the LORD.
verses.2: Sin directs the heart of the wicked; their eyes are closed to the fear of God.
verses.3: For they live with the delusion: their guilt will not be known and hated.
verses.4: Empty and false are the words of their mouth; they have ceased to be wise and do good.
verses.5: In their beds they hatch plots; they set out on a wicked way; they do not reject evil.
verses.6: LORD, your love reaches to heaven; your fidelity, to the clouds.
verses.7: Your justice is like the highest mountains; your judgments, like the mighty deep; all living creatures you sustain, LORD.
verses.8: How precious is your love, O God! We take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
verses.9: We feast on the rich food of your house; from your delightful stream you give us drink.
verses.10: For with you is the fountain of life, and in your light we see light.
verses.11: Continue your kindness toward your friends, your just defense of the honest heart.
verses.12: Do not let the foot of the proud overtake me, nor the hand of the wicked disturb me.
verses.13: There make the evildoers fall; thrust them down, never to rise.

notes.text: Love... judgments: God actively controls the entire world.
The shadow of your wings: metaphor for divine protection. It probably refers to the winged cherubim in the holy of holies in the temple. Cf 1 Kings 6:23-28, 32;
